questions.question: A boat takes 27 minutes to go 37.2 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat instill water to that of the stream is 8 : 5. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 79.4 km upstream and 85.8 km downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Upstream speed** (U) = 37.2 km / (27/60) h = 82.67 kmph

Ratio **Boat** : **Stream** = 8 : 5 → **Upstream ratio** = 8 − 5 = 3 units; **Downstream ratio** = 8 + 5 = 13 units.

3 units = 82.66 kmph ⇒ 1 unit = 27.55 kmph ⇒ Downstream (13 units) = 358.22 kmph.

Total Time = (79.4 / 82.66) + (85.8 / 358.22) ≈ 0.96 + 0.24 = 1.2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bb5b09ee316b50a36e61f1327c45fac86ad93f23c873ed057a1340a6a4987b8.png] 

**Given:** Upstream Distance = 37.2 km, Time = 27 min, Ratio of Boat speed (v) to Stream speed (u) = 8 : 5.

**Formula:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time | Upstream Speed (U) = v − u | Downstream Speed (D) = v + u.

⇒ U = 37.2 ÷ (27/60) = (37.2 × 60) ÷ 27 = 2232 ÷ 27 = 82.666... kmph.

⇒ Let v = 8x and u = 5x. Then U = 8x − 5x = 3x.

⇒ 3x = 82.666... ⇒ x = 27.555... kmph.

⇒ Downstream Speed (D) = 8x + 5x = 13x = 13 × 27.555... = 358.222... kmph.

⇒ Time for 79.4 km upstream = 79.4 ÷ 82.666... = 0.9605 hours.

⇒ Time for 85.8 km downstream = 85.8 ÷ 358.222... = 0.2395 hours.

⇒ Total Time = 0.9605 + 0.2395 = 1.2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Water

Upstream speed is the difference (v − u) and Downstream speed is the sum (v + u) of the boat and stream speeds.

Conversion of Time

To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60. To calculate speed in kmph, distance in km must be divided by time in hours.

Boat Speed Calculation

Speed of boat in still water (v) = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2 and Stream speed (u) = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: In what time (in years) will ₹2,500 fetch an interest of ₹1,000 at 10% per year simple interest?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interest for 1 year = 10% of **₹2,500** = **₹250**

Total interest to be fetched = **₹1,000**

**Time** = Total Interest ÷ Interest per year

⇒ **Time** = 1000 ÷ 250 = 4 years

**∴ The correct answer is 4 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹2,500

**Simple Interest (SI)** = ₹1,000

**Rate (R)** = 10% per annum

**Formula Used:**

**Simple Interest (SI)** = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c145dd59f81b4564a611278147ec8ec41980e034b373221e61e1a4926789b1d4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1000 = (2500 × 10 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 1000 = 250 × T

⇒ T = 1000 ÷ 250

⇒ T = 4 years

**∴ The correct answer is 4 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount in Simple Interest

Amount (A) is the sum of Principal (P) and Interest (I). Formula: A = P + (P × R × T) ÷ 100 or A = P(1 + RT/100).

Compound Interest (CI) vs Simple Interest (SI)

Simple interest is calculated only on the principal, whereas CI is calculated on the principal plus the accumulated interest of previous periods.

Rule of 72

A quick way to estimate how long it takes to double your money: Time ≈ 72 ÷ Rate (usually applied to Compound Interest).

questions.question: By how much is 60% of 40 greater than (2)/(5) of 55?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Find: (60% of 40) − (2/5 of 55)

**Formula used:**

Percentage: (p% of q) = (p × q) ÷ 100

Fraction: (m/n of q) = (m × q) ÷ n

**Calculations:**

⇒ 60% of 40 = (60 × 40) ÷ 100 = 2400 ÷ 100 = 24

⇒ (2/5) of 55 = (2 × 55) ÷ 5 = 110 ÷ 5 = 22

⇒ Difference = 24 − 22 = 2

**∴ 60% of 40 is greater by 2.**

questions.question: If A's salary is 16% more than that of B, then by what percentage is B's salary less than that of A (correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required percentage = [r ÷ (100 + r)] × 100

Given **r = 16%**

Required % = [16 ÷ (100 + 16)] × 100

Required % = [16 ÷ 116] × 100 = 400 ÷ 29 ≈ 13.79%

**∴ The correct answer is 13.79%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e20661ec35cbd3bf53a8b2be815e0befa91e0a57dbc310ad6a0955b38fce60b5.png] 

**Given:**

**A's salary** is 16% more than **B's salary**.

⇒ Let **B's salary** = 100

⇒ **A's salary** = 100 + 16% of 100 = 116

**Calculations:**

⇒ Difference between **A** and **B** = 116 − 100 = 16

⇒ **B's salary** is less than **A's salary** by = (Difference ÷ A's salary) × 100

⇒ Percentage less = (16 ÷ 116) × 100

⇒ Percentage less = (4 ÷ 29) × 100

⇒ Percentage less = 400 ÷ 29 = 13.7931...

⇒ Correct to two decimal places = 13.79%

**∴ The correct answer is 13.79%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Comparison Rule

If A is **r% more** than B, then B is **[r ÷ (100 + r)] × 100%** less than A.

Inverse Case

If A is **r% less** than B, then B is **[r ÷ (100 − r)] × 100%** more than A.

Base Value Concept

The percentage change depends on the **denominator (base value)**. When comparing B to A, **A's value** becomes the base.</p

questions.question: If a² + b² = 90 and ab = 27, then find the possible value of(a+b)/(a-b)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Required value = √[(Sum of squares + 2 × Product) ÷ (Sum of squares − 2 × Product)]

Ratio = √[(90 + 2 × 27) ÷ (90 − 2 × 27)]

Ratio = √[144 ÷ 36] = 12 ÷ 6 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **a² + b² = 90**

⇒ **ab = 27**

**Formula Used:**

⇒ **(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab**

⇒ **(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe27d27b36e11017adc8ba45a9d7e23cf22e1a7a0ce8d8aead0a0fc9d5009ddc.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (a + b)² = 90 + 2(27) = 144

⇒ a + b = √144 = 12

⇒ (a − b)² = 90 − 2(27) = 36

⇒ a − b = √36 = 6

⇒ Required fraction = (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = 12 ÷ 6 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for 4ab

The relationship between the square of the sum and the square of the difference is given by (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab.

Sum of Squares

The sum of squares a² + b² can be expressed as ((a + b)² + (a − b)²) ÷ 2.

Difference of Squares

The product of the sum and difference of two numbers results in the difference of their squares: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².</p

questions.question: A student scored the following marks: 78, 85, 69, and 90 in four subjects. What score is required in the fifth subject to achieve an average of 80 marks across all five subjects?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Target **Average** = 80. Calculate **Net Deviation** of given marks from 80.

Deviations: (78−80) + (85−80) + (69−80) + (90−80) ⇒ −2 + 5 − 11 + 10 = +2.

To keep average at 80, **Net Deviation** must be 0. So, 5th subject deviation must be −2.

5th subject score = Target Average + Required Deviation ⇒ 80 + (−2) = 78.

**∴ The correct answer is 78 marks.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marks in 4 subjects = 78, 85, 69, 90; Required **Average** for 5 subjects = 80.

**Formula Used:** Total Sum = Average × Number of Observations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07c15cd6cd79fb63c81a89034765e974799c29a4cce4a1c214afea9b02a21757.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total marks required for 5 subjects = 80 × 5 = 400.

⇒ Sum of marks in 4 subjects = 78 + 85 + 69 + 90.

⇒ Sum of 4 subjects = 322.

⇒ Marks required in 5th subject = Total required marks − Current sum.

⇒ Marks in 5th subject = 400 − 322 = 78.

**∴ The correct answer is 78 marks.**

**__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

It is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations. Formula: Mean (μ) = Σx / n.

Net Deviation Rule

The algebraic sum of **deviations** of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero. This is a powerful tool for solving missing value problems in averages.

New Observation Entry

New Observation = (New Average × New Count) − (Old Average × Old Count).</p

questions.question: The median of the observations 87, 56, 27, 31, 13, 39, 18, 80, 98, 92 and 25 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the data in **ascending order**: 13, 18, 25, 27, 31, 39, 56, 80, 87, 92, 98.

Total number of observations (n) = 11 (which is **Odd**).

Median = Middle term = ((11 + 1) / 2)th term = 6th term.

The 6th term in the sorted list is 39.

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Observations = 87, 56, 27, 31, 13, 39, 18, 80, 98, 92, 25.

**Formula Used:** Median = ((n + 1) / 2)th term (when n is odd).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76efce3a1828ac0ebda6871175b88bc4a697ceebcb4a7eb1df161155aa02626c.png] 

⇒ Arrange observations in **ascending order**: 13, 18, 25, 27, 31, 39, 56, 80, 87, 92, 98.

⇒ Count of observations (n) = 11.

⇒ Median = ((11 + 1) / 2)th term.

⇒ Median = 6th term.

⇒ 6th term = 39.

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Even n

If the number of observations (n) is even, the median is the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

Mean (Average)

Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Mode

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set. A set can have one mode, more than one mode, or no mode.</p

questions.question: A (x, 5), B (3, -4) and C (-6, y) are the three vertices of a triangle ABC. If (3.5, 4.5) is the centroid of the triangle, find the point (x + 3, y - 4)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of x-coordinates = 3 × Centroidₓ ⇒ x + 3 − 6 = 3 × 3.5 = 10.5 ⇒ x = 13.5.

Sum of y-coordinates = 3 × Centroidy ⇒ 5 − 4 + y = 3 × 4.5 = 13.5 ⇒ y = 12.5.

Required point (x + 3, y − 4) = (13.5 + 3, 12.5 − 4) = (16.5, 8.5).

**∴ The correct answer is (16.5, 8.5).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Vertices of triangle are **A(x, 5)**, **B(3, −4)**, and **C(−6, y)**. The **centroid** is **G(3.5, 4.5)**.

**Formula Used:** Centroid G(X, Y) of a triangle with vertices (x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂), and (x₃, y₃) is given by:

X = (x₁ + x₂ + x₃) / 3 and Y = (y₁ + y₂ + y₃) / 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0e18447abea67554e2b6b9865013b02ad9669a1f7d4da83d0e561c8a03b006e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3.5 = (x + 3 + (−6)) / 3

⇒ 3.5 × 3 = x − 3

⇒ 10.5 = x − 3 ⇒ **x = 13.5**

⇒ 4.5 = (5 + (−4) + y) / 3

⇒ 4.5 × 3 = 1 + y

⇒ 13.5 = 1 + y ⇒ **y = 12.5**

⇒ Required point = (x + 3, y − 4)

⇒ Point = (13.5 + 3, 12.5 − 4)

⇒ Point = (16.5, 8.5)

**∴ The correct answer is (16.5, 8.5).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Centroid Properties

The **centroid** is the intersection of the three **medians** and always lies inside the triangle. It divides each median in a **2:1 ratio**.

Area of Triangle (Coordinate Geometry)

Area = 0.5 × |x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)|. If the area is zero, the points are **collinear**.

Section Formula

A point dividing a line segment joining (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) in ratio m:n is ((mx₂ + nx₁)/(m+n), (my₂ + ny₁)/(m+n)).</p

questions.question: X varies inversely as Y and Y varies inversely as Z. In a particular ca X = (1)/(16) and Z = (1)/(32) What will be the value of X when Z = 3?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X varies inversely as Y and Y varies inversely as Z.

Initial values: X = 1/16 and Z = 1/32.

New value: Z = 3.

**Formula Used:**

X × Y = k₁ (constant for X and Y).

Y × Z = k₂ (constant for Y and Z).

**Calculation:**

From X × Y = k₁ and Y × Z = k₂:

Y = k₁ / X, Z = k₂ / Y.

⇒ Z = k₂ / (k₁ / X).

⇒ Z = X × k₂ / k₁.

From the initial values, substitute X = 1/16 and Z = 1/32:

k₂ / k₁ = Z / X = (1/32) / (1/16).

k₂ / k₁ = 1/32 × 16/1 = 1/2.

Now, when Z = 3:

⇒ Z = X × k₂ / k₁.

⇒ 3 = X × (1/2).

⇒ X = 3 × 2.

⇒ X = 6.

**The value of X when Z = 3 is 6.**

questions.question: The average of eight numbers is 80. Find the least number if it is (1)/(16) of the sum of the numbers.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **sum** of **eight numbers** = **Average** × **Count** = 80 × 8 = 640.

The **least number** is 1/16 of the total **sum**.

Value = 640 ÷ 16 = 40.

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total count of numbers = 8

**Average** of numbers = 80

Condition: **Least number** = 1/16 × **Sum**

**Formula:**

Total Sum = **Average** × Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7fdfc859674513386f3c531f8e03ade85bc1e19dcae9b1b57913783322bd73c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Total Sum** of 8 numbers = 80 × 8 = 640

⇒ **Least number** = (1/16) × 640

⇒ **Least number** = 640 ÷ 16

⇒ **Least number** = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

**__Additional Information__**

Concept of Average

The **average** is the central value of a set of data, calculated by Sum ÷ Count.

Summation Property

If the **average** of 'n' numbers is 'x', then their **total sum** is always n × x.

Fractional Parts

To find a specific **fractional part** of a total, multiply the total by the numerator and divide by the denominator.</p

questions.question: The profit made on a product is 79%. What is the loss percentage (correct to two 3 decimal places) incurred on the sale if the figures of both the cost price and the selling price are interchanged?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume **Cost Price (CP)** = 100. Then **Selling Price (SP)** = 179.

When CP and SP are **interchanged**, New CP = 179 and New SP = 100.

Loss = 179 − 100 = 79.

**Loss%** = (79 ÷ 179) × 100.

Calculation: 7900 ÷ 179 ≈ 44.134%.

**∴ The correct answer is 44.13%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Profit = 79%, New CP = Old SP, New SP = Old CP.

**Formulas:** SP = CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100 | Loss% = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a51efa27abb01c8e2e9dd55473b5e12651be9fd53cc14b38da985f4f0db326d8.png] 

⇒ Let **Initial Cost Price (CP₁)** = 100 units.

⇒ Initial Profit = 79%, so **Initial Selling Price (SP₁)** = 179 units.

⇒ After interchanging, **New Cost Price (CP₂)** = 179 units and **New Selling Price (SP₂)** = 100 units.

⇒ New Loss = CP₂ − SP₂ = 179 − 100 = 79 units.

⇒ **Loss Percentage** = (Loss ÷ CP₂) × 100 = (79 ÷ 179) × 100.

⇒ Loss% = 44.13407...% ≈ 44.13%.

**∴ The correct answer is 44.13%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit or Loss is always calculated on the **Cost Price** unless specified otherwise. Formula: Profit% = (P/CP)×100 and Loss% = (L/CP)×100.

Interchanging CP and SP

If a transaction results in a profit, interchanging CP and SP will always result in a loss. The **absolute value** of the profit/loss remains the same, but the **percentage** changes because the base (CP) changes.</p

questions.question: 15 chairs and 19 tables cost ₹5,300 and 19 chairs and 19 tables cost ₹5,700. What is the cost of 12 chairs and 13 tables?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Subtract the two scenarios: (19 chairs + 19 tables) − (15 chairs + 19 tables) = ₹5,700 − ₹5,300.

This gives 4 **chairs** = ₹400 ⇒ Cost of 1 **chair** = ₹100.

From the second set: 19 **tables** = 5,700 − (19 × 100) = ₹3,800 ⇒ Cost of 1 **table** = ₹200.

Required cost for 12 **chairs** and 13 **tables** = (12 × 100) + (13 × 200) = 1,200 + 2,600 = ₹3,800.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,800.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost of 15 chairs and 19 tables = ₹5,300

Cost of 19 chairs and 19 tables = ₹5,700

**Formula Used:**

Total Cost = (Number of chairs × Price per chair) + (Number of tables × Price per table)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d92dc91ab38a3fc8d7e630316c9a985dec811b83f736c670189687f152f44686.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let C be the cost of one **chair** and T be the cost of one **table**.

⇒ 15C + 19T = 5300 — (Eq. 1)

⇒ 19C + 19T = 5700 — (Eq. 2)

⇒ Subtracting Eq. 1 from Eq. 2:

⇒ (19C − 15C) + (19T − 19T) = 5700 − 5300

⇒ 4C = 400

⇒ C = 100

⇒ Substitute C = 100 in Eq. 2:

⇒ 19(100) + 19T = 5700

⇒ 1900 + 19T = 5700

⇒ 19T = 5700 − 1900 = 3800

⇒ T = 3800 ÷ 19 = 200

⇒ Cost of 12 chairs and 13 tables = 12C + 13T

⇒ Cost = 12(100) + 13(200) = 1200 + 2600 = 3800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,800.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simultaneous Linear Equations

Equations with two variables can be solved using the **elimination method** (removing one variable) or the **substitution method**.

Unitary Method

Finding the value of a **single unit** first helps in calculating the value of any required number of units easily.

Total Cost Formula

Total Cost = ∑ (Rateᵢ × Quantityᵢ). For multiple items, sum the individual costs of each item category.

questions.question: The volume and height of a cylinder are 8470 cm³ and 2.2 cm, respectively. Find the radius (in cm) of the cylinder. Use pi = (22)/(7)

r² = 8470 ÷ ((22/7) × 2.2)

r² = (8470 × 7) ÷ (22 × 2.2) = (8470 × 7) ÷ 48.4 = 1225.

r = √1225 = 35 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Volume (V)** = 8470 cm³

**Height (h)** = 2.2 cm

**π** = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of Cylinder** = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5183cf09d9cb34e0934924bcdf58127aeca68e323ee628d89c70b4864f7b94fb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 8470 = (22/7) × r² × 2.2

⇒ 8470 = (22 × 2.2 / 7) × r²

⇒ 8470 = (48.4 / 7) × r²

⇒ r² = (8470 × 7) ÷ 48.4

⇒ r² = 59290 ÷ 48.4

⇒ r² = 1225

⇒ r = √1225

⇒ r = 35 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 35 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cylinder

The lateral area excluding the top and bottom bases: CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The sum of the CSA and the area of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Hollow Cylinder

The volume of the material between two concentric cylinders: V = π(R² − r²)h.</p

questions.question: The LCM of 48, 88 and another number, x, is 4752. Which of the following can be the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Prime Factorization** of given numbers:

48 = 2⁴ × 3¹

88 = 2³ × 11¹

**LCM** = 4752 = 2⁴ × 3³ × 11¹

Since the **LCM** has 3³, and neither 48 nor 88 contains 3³, **x** must be a multiple of 3³ (27). Only 216 is divisible by 27.

**∴ The correct answer is 216.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers are 48, 88, and **x**. **LCM** = 4752.

**Step 1:** Find the **prime factors** of the given numbers.

⇒ 48 = 16 × 3 = 2⁴ × 3¹

⇒ 88 = 8 × 11 = 2³ × 11¹

**Step 2:** Find the **prime factors** of the **LCM**.

⇒ 4752 = 2 × 2376 = 2² × 1188 = 2³ × 594 = 2⁴ × 297

⇒ 297 = 27 × 11 = 3³ × 11¹

⇒ **LCM** (48, 88, **x**) = 2⁴ × 3³ × 11¹

**Step 3:** Compare factors. **LCM** is the product of highest powers of all prime factors present in the numbers.

⇒ Power of 2 in LCM is 2⁴ (comes from 48).

⇒ Power of 11 in LCM is 11¹ (comes from 88).

⇒ Power of 3 in LCM is 3³. However, 48 has only 3¹ and 88 has 3⁰.

⇒ Therefore, **x** must contain 3³ = 27 as a factor.

**Step 4:** Check options for multiples of 27.

⇒ 216 = 27 × 8 (Satisfies the condition).

**∴ The correct answer is 216.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Definition

**Least Common Multiple** is the product of the highest powers of all prime factors involved in the numbers.

HCF vs LCM Relation

For two numbers **a** and **b**: **a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b)**. This does not directly apply to three numbers.

Divisibility Rule of 27

A number is divisible by 27 if the sum of its digits in blocks of three from right to left is divisible by 27.</p

questions.question: A motorist covers a distance of 30 km in 50 minutes by moving at a speed of x km/hr for the first 13 minutes, then moving at the speed of 2x km/hr for the next 25 minutes and then again moving at the speed of x km/hr for the rest of the journey. The value of x is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time = 50 minutes. Breakdown: 13 mins (x), 25 mins (2x), and remaining (50 − 13 − 25) = 12 mins (x).

Total **Equivalent Time** at speed x = 13 + (25 × 2) + 12 = 13 + 50 + 12 = 75 minutes.

Distance = Speed × Time ⇒ 30 km = x × (75/60) hours.

x = (30 × 60) ÷ 75 = 1800 ÷ 75 = 24 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39eab6c88357c4165bde0d3619593a7fd81ed9a3a2ae66657e3ffba47d147a91.png] 

**Given:** Total Distance = 30 km, Total Time = 50 min.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Third part time = 50 − (13 + 25) = 12 minutes.

⇒ Distance₁ = x × (13/60) km

⇒ Distance₂ = 2x × (25/60) km

⇒ Distance₃ = x × (12/60) km

⇒ Total Distance = (13x/60) + (50x/60) + (12x/60) = 30

⇒ 75x/60 = 30

⇒ 5x/4 = 30

⇒ 5x = 120

⇒ x = 24 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. In this case, 30 km ÷ (50/60) hours = 36 km/hr.

Unit Conversion

To convert **minutes to hours**, divide by 60. To convert **km/hr to m/s**, multiply by 5/18.

Distance with Variable Speeds

Total Distance = (S₁ × T₁) + (S₂ × T₂) + ... + (Sₙ × Tₙ), ensuring all units are consistent.</p

questions.question:
Simplify:

(cot theta)/(operatorname{cosec) theta+1}+frac{operatorname{cosec} theta+1}{cot theta}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put **θ = 30°** in the given expression.

cot 30° = √3 and cosec 30° = 2.

Expression = [√3 / (2 + 1)] + [(2 + 1) / √3] = [√3 / 3] + [3 / √3] = [1 / √3] + √3 = (1 + 3) / √3 = 4 / √3.

Check options for θ = 30°: 2sec 30° = 2 × (2 / √3) = 4 / √3.

**∴ The correct answer is 2secθ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** [cot θ / (cosec θ + 1)] + [(cosec θ + 1) / cot θ]

**Formula Used:** cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1 ⇒ cot²θ = cosec²θ − 1 = (cosec θ + 1)(cosec θ − 1)

⇒ Taking LCM: [cot²θ + (cosec θ + 1)²] / [cot θ(cosec θ + 1)]

⇒ [cot²θ + cosec²θ + 1 + 2cosec θ] / [cot θ(cosec θ + 1)]

⇒ [(cosec²θ − 1) + cosec²θ + 1 + 2cosec θ] / [cot θ(cosec θ + 1)]

⇒ [2cosec²θ + 2cosec θ] / [cot θ(cosec θ + 1)]

⇒ [2cosec θ (cosec θ + 1)] / [cot θ (cosec θ + 1)]

⇒ 2cosec θ / cot θ = 2(1 / sin θ) / (cos θ / sin θ)

⇒ 2 / cos θ = 2sec θ

**∴ The correct answer is 2secθ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Standard Pythagorean identities include sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

sec θ = 1/cos θ, cosec θ = 1/sin θ, and cot θ = cos θ/sin θ.</p

questions.question: A and B complete a work in 2 days. If A alone can do it in 38 days, then B alone can do 9-times of the same work in days.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Combined efficiency of **A + B** = 1/2 work/day

Efficiency of **A** = 1/38 work/day

Efficiency of **B** = 1/2 − 1/38 = (19 − 1)/38 = 18/38 = 9/19 work/day

Time for **B** to do 9-times work = (Total work × 9) ÷ Efficiency of B = 9 ÷ (9/19) = 19 days

**∴ The correct answer is 19 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **A + B** = 2 days

Time taken by **A** alone = 38 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of time taken

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken

 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 A + B 2 38 19 
 A 38 1 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of A

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = 19 − 1 = 18

⇒ New work to be done = 9 × Total Work = 9 × 38

⇒ Time taken by **B** = (9 × 38) ÷ 18

⇒ Time taken by **B** = 342 ÷ 18 = 19 days

**∴ The correct answer is 19 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relationship

Efficiency is **inversely proportional** to the time taken to complete a work. If a person completes work in 'n' days, their 1-day work is 1/n.

Combined Work Formula

If A takes 'x' days and B takes 'y' days, together they take (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days to complete the **same work**.</p

questions.question: The shorter side of a rectangle is 21 cm less than the longer side. The numerical value of its area is equal to 7 times the numerical value of its perimeter. What is the length (in cm) of its longer side?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **longer side** be L. Then the **shorter side** is L − 21.

Area = 7 × Perimeter ⇒ L × (L − 21) = 7 × 2 × [L + (L − 21)]

L² − 21L = 14(2L − 21) ⇒ L² − 21L = 28L − 294

L² − 49L + 294 = 0. Solving this: (L − 42)(L − 7) = 0.

Since L > 21, the only possible value for the **longer side** is 42 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b4bba9c35121a366a4effa2e087f6b4c3296c0fdb955b6e428d1bd638f84c1a.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Let **Longer side** = x cm

⇒ **Shorter side** = (x − 21) cm

**Formula Used:**

⇒ **Area of Rectangle** = Length × Breadth

⇒ **Perimeter of Rectangle** = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = 7 × Perimeter

⇒ x(x − 21) = 7 × 2[x + (x − 21)]

⇒ x² − 21x = 14(2x − 21)

⇒ x² − 21x = 28x − 294

⇒ x² − 49x + 294 = 0

⇒ x² − 42x − 7x + 294 = 0

⇒ x(x − 42) − 7(x − 42) = 0

⇒ (x − 42)(x − 7) = 0

⇒ x = 42 or x = 7

⇒ Since the side must be greater than 21 (as x − 21 must be positive), x = 42 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Rectangle

A rectangle is a quadrilateral with four right angles. Opposite sides are equal and parallel. Diagonals are equal and bisect each other.

Diagonal Formula

The length of the diagonal (d) of a rectangle is given by d = √(L² + B²).

Quadratic Root Selection

In geometry word problems, always check if the calculated side length makes all other dimensions (like L − 21) positive real numbers.</p

questions.question: Mukesh sold a car for ₹1,20,000 at 40% loss. For what price (in ₹) should he sell the carto gain 55% profit?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio method: Let the **Cost Price (CP)** be 100%.

First selling price (SP₁) = 100% − 40% = 60%.

Desired selling price (SP₂) = 100% + 55% = 155%.

Given: 60% → 1,20,000. So, 1% → 1,20,000 ÷ 60 = 2,000.

Required SP₂ = 155 × 2,000 = 3,10,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,10,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Selling Price (SP₁) = ₹1,20,000, Loss% = 40%, Required Profit% = 55%.

**Formulas:** CP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − Loss%); SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd6d67ac03e9e7cb2ab4cb9110605313ab7bb8634d24bd7554b59299885b10d3.png] 

⇒ **Cost Price (CP)** = 1,20,000 × 100 ÷ (100 − 40) = 1,20,000 × 100 ÷ 60.

⇒ **Cost Price (CP)** = 2,00,000.

⇒ **New Selling Price (SP₂)** = 2,00,000 × (100 + 55) ÷ 100.

⇒ **New Selling Price (SP₂)** = 2,00,000 × 155 ÷ 100 = 2,000 × 155.

⇒ **New Selling Price (SP₂)** = 3,10,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,10,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cost Price & Selling Price Relationship

When an object is sold at a loss, the **Cost Price** is always greater than the **Selling Price**. CP = SP + Loss.

Direct SP Calculation

To find the new SP directly: SP₂ = SP₁ × (100 + Profit%) ÷ (100 − Loss%).

questions.question: A sum of ₹x amounts to ₹83,853 in 2(1)/(2) years at 12% p.a., interest compounded 10-monthly. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **10-monthly** compounding, rate per period = 12% × (10/12) = **10%**.

Total periods for 2.5 years (30 months) = 30 ÷ 10 = **3 periods**.

Using **Ratio Method**: 10% = 1/10 ⇒ Amount/Principal = (11/10)³ = 1331/1000.

1331 units = ₹83,853 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹83,853 ÷ 1331 = ₹63.

Principal (x) = 1000 units = 1000 × 63 = ₹63,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹63,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Amount (A)** = ₹83,853 | **Annual Rate (R)** = 12% | **Time (T)** = 2.5 years = 30 months.

**Compounding** = 10-monthly.

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f3e84dc710be53c97754d136f4f911dc607a3b102f95ae233c8846181cd5574.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Effective rate (r) = 12% × (10/12) = 10% per period

⇒ Number of periods (n) = 30 ÷ 10 = 3

⇒ 83,853 = x(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 83,853 = x(1.1)³

⇒ 83,853 = x × 1.331

⇒ x = 83,853 ÷ 1.331

⇒ x = 83,853,000 ÷ 1331

⇒ x = 63,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹63,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for Compounding

When interest is compounded k-monthly, the rate used is (R ÷ 12) × k and the number of periods is (Total months ÷ k).

Compound Interest Formula

Amount A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ, where P is principal, r is rate per period, and n is the number of periods.

Successive Percentage Method

For 3 periods of 10% each, the effective percentage increase is 10 + 10 + (10×10)/100 = 21%, then 21 + 10 + (21×10)/100 = 33.1%.

questions.question: If x +(1)/(x) = 17 then x²+(1)/(x²⁾.is
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

If the value of **x + 1/x = k**, then the value of **x² + 1/x²** is always **k² − 2**.

Given that **k = 17**.

⇒ **x² + 1/x²** = 17² − 2

⇒ 289 − 2 = 287.

**∴ The correct answer is 287.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **x + 1/x = 17**

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ **Squaring** both sides of the equation x + 1/x = 17:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 17²

⇒ x² + (1/x)² + 2 × x × (1/x) = 289

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 289

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 289 − 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 287

**∴ The correct answer is 287.**

**__Additional Information__**

Cube Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then the value of x³ + 1/x³ is given by the formula k³ − 3k.

Negative Sign Identity

If x − 1/x = k, then the value of x² + 1/x² is calculated as k² + 2.

Fourth Power Identity

To find x⁴ + 1/x⁴ when x + 1/x = k, use the formula (k² − 2)² − 2.</p

questions.question: The successive discounts of 29%, 18% and 9% are equivalent to a single discount of: (Rounded up to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount for **29%** and **18%** = 29 + 18 − (29 × 18) ÷ 100 = 47 − 5.22 = **41.78%**.

Now, combine **41.78%** and **9%** = 41.78 + 9 − (41.78 × 9) ÷ 100.

= 50.78 − 3.7602 = **47.0198%**.

Rounding to two decimal places, we get **47.02%**.

**∴ The correct answer is 47.02%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → Three successive discounts **d₁ = 29%**, **d₂ = 18%**, and **d₃ = 9%**.
Formulas: **Net Discount = 100 − [100 × (100−d₁)/100 × (100−d₂)/100 × (100−d₃)/100]**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45bbdf11683f948cfb870de57fd2a424e63f87b78d983df5698aa3a3b3b56589.png] 
⇒ Final Price = 100 × (71/100) × (82/100) × (91/100)
⇒ Final Price = 100 × 0.71 × 0.82 × 0.91
⇒ Final Price = 52.9802
⇒ Single Equivalent Discount = 100 − 52.9802 = 47.0198%
⇒ Equivalent Discount ≈ 47.02%

**∴ The correct answer is 47.02%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When a series of discounts are applied one after another on the reducing balance, they are called successive discounts. The **order** in which successive discounts are applied does not change the final result.

Single Equivalent Discount Formula

For two discounts a% and b%, the equivalent discount is **(a + b − ab/100)%**. For three, apply the formula to the first two, then to the result and the third.</p

questions.question: Find the roots of the quadratic equation 5x² - 12x - 17 = 0
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For the equation 5x² − 12x − 17 = 0, find two numbers that multiply to (5 × −17) = −85 and add to −12.

The numbers are −17 and +5.

The roots are obtained by changing the signs of these numbers and dividing by the coefficient of x² (a = 5).

Roots = −(−17)/5 and −(5)/5 ⇒ 17/5 and −1.

**∴ The correct answer is -1, 17/5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given Equation:** 5x² − 12x − 17 = 0

**Method:** Factorization by splitting the middle term

⇒ 5x² − 17x + 5x − 17 = 0

⇒ x(5x − 17) + 1(5x − 17) = 0

⇒ (5x − 17)(x + 1) = 0

Now, set each factor equal to zero:

⇒ 5x − 17 = 0 ⇒ 5x = 17 ⇒ x = 17/5

⇒ x + 1 = 0 ⇒ x = −1

The roots of the equation are −1 and 17/5.

**∴ The correct answer is -1, 17/5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Discriminant and Nature of Roots

The discriminant D is given by b² − 4ac. Since D = (−12)² − 4(5)(−17) = 144 + 340 = 484 > 0, the roots are real and distinct.

Sum and Product of Roots

For ax² + bx + c = 0, sum of roots = −b/a and product of roots = c/a. Here, sum = 12/5 and product = −17/5.

Quadratic Formula

Roots can also be found using x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)] / 2a.</p

questions.question: A cistern can be filled with water by a pipe in 10 hours, and it can be emptied by asecond pipe in 8 hours. If both the pipes are opened when the cistern is full, the time in which it will be emptied is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Time to empty = (**Filling time** × **Emptying time**) ÷ (**Emptying time** − **Filling time**)

Required time = (10 × 8) ÷ (10 − 8)

Required time = 80 ÷ 2 = 40 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Filling pipe (A) = 10 hours

Emptying pipe (B) = 8 hours

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of individual times

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

 **Pipe** **Time (hr)** **Total Capacity (LCM)** **Efficiency (units/hr)**
 A (Filling) 10 40 units +4
 B (Emptying) 8 −5
⇒ Net efficiency of (A + B) = +4 − 5 = −1 unit/hr

⇒ Negative sign indicates the cistern is being emptied.

⇒ Time to empty full cistern = Total Capacity ÷ Net Efficiency

⇒ Time = 40 ÷ 1 = 40 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inlet and Outlet Pipes

An **Inlet pipe** fills the tank (positive efficiency), while an **Outlet pipe** empties it (negative efficiency).

Net Work Done

If efficiency of the outlet pipe is greater than the inlet pipe, a full tank will always be **emptied**.

Total Work Assumption

Total capacity is usually taken as the **LCM** of time taken by individual pipes for easier calculations.</p

questions.question: Vikram, Anjali and Raj started a business in partnership, investing in the ratio of 7: 3: 20, respectively. At the end of the year, they earned a profit of ₹28,800, which is 25% of their total investment. How much did Anjali invest (in₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Investment = Profit ÷ Profit% = 28,800 ÷ 25% = 28,800 × 4 = ₹1,15,200.

Ratio of investments = 7 : 3 : 20. Total ratio parts = 7 + 3 + 20 = 30.

Anjali's share = (3 ÷ 30) × Total Investment = 1 ÷ 10 × 1,15,200.

Anjali's Investment = ₹11,520.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,520.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → Investment ratio = 7 : 3 : 20 | Profit = ₹28,800 | Profit% = 25%.
Formulas: Total Investment = (Profit ÷ Profit%) × 100 | Individual Investment = (Individual Ratio ÷ Total Ratio) × Total Investment.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29d5f7b419976241c36344b56aacdf424cf455f899eab699f7be13413614b5c3.png] 
⇒ Let the investments of **Vikram, Anjali, and Raj** be 7x, 3x, and 20x respectively.
⇒ Total Investment = 7x + 3x + 20x = 30x.
⇒ According to the question, 25% of 30x = 28,800.
⇒ (25 ÷ 100) × 30x = 28,800 ⇒ 7.5x = 28,800.
⇒ x = 28,800 ÷ 7.5 = 3,840.
⇒ Anjali's investment = 3x = 3 × 3,840 = ₹11,520.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,520.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Profit Distribution

In a partnership, if the time period is the same, **Profit** is distributed in the same ratio as the **Investments**.

Investment Calculation

Total Capital = (Individual Profit × 100) ÷ (Profit percentage on total capital). Here, the 25% applies to the **sum of all investments**.

questions.question: If a : b :: b : c, c = 9a and b = 6, then find the positive value of c.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given **a, b, c** are in **continued proportion** (a : b :: b : c).

The relation is **b² = ac**.

Substitute **b = 6** and **c = 9a** (so **a = c/9**).

6² = (c/9) × c ⇒ 36 = c² / 9 ⇒ c² = 324 ⇒ c = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Proportion: **a : b :: b : c**

Values: **b = 6**, **c = 9a**

**Formula Used:**

For continued proportion, **Product of extremes = Product of means** ⇒ **ac = b²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d63bc6a3eb1962bee536a999d590ae6787b246d2422afee54129f24c6359a124.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ a/b = b/c

⇒ b² = a × c

⇒ Substitute c = 9a → a = c/9

⇒ 6² = (c/9) × c

⇒ 36 = c² / 9

⇒ c² = 36 × 9

⇒ c² = 324

⇒ c = √324

⇒ c = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

**__Additional Information__**

Continued Proportion

Three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion if a/b = b/c. Here, b is called the **mean proportional** between a and c.

Mean Proportional Formula

The mean proportional **b** between two numbers **a** and **c** is calculated as **b = √(ac)**.

Third Proportional

In the proportion a : b :: b : c, the term **c** is known as the **third proportional** to a and b, where **c = b²/a**.</p
